name: Arikawa Masaomi
source:
The protagonist's childhood friend and classmate. Yuzuru's older brother.
One of the Hachiyou that protects the Priestess, the Seiryuu of Heaven.
A firm and reliable young man.
When he got summoned to the other world he got separated from the protagonist and his brother, they reunited later but...
